title.th: คำสั่งแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมคำสั่งศุลกากร พ.ศ. 2561

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-21-2013-CUSTOMS-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2018.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 3 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Customs (Amendment) Order, 2013. of new section 22A into S 39/2006.

The Customs Order, 2006, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is by inserting the following new section immediately after section 22 - "Customs ruling. 22A. The Controller may, on his own discretion or on an application made in accordance with such regulations made under this Order, make a ruling on any of the matters specified in such regulations and such ruling shall bind the applicant.". of section 152.

Section 152 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (2) - {a} in paragraph {zi}, by deleting the fullstop and by substituting a semicolon therefor; {b) by adding the following new paragraph "{zj} the conduct of all matters relating to customs rulings.". Made this 7th. day of Jamadilawal, 1434 Hijriah corresponding to the 19th. day of March, 2013 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
